comments.body:
Florentine recipe, "Triangular cap sewing method" (Garment Maker; no sewing skill/rank required)
Ingredients:
Knitted Fabric x10
Cotton Fabric x10
Fine Fur x5
Cost: 100 sewing contribution consumption

Stats: +1 Art Trading, color-customizable, 1k total fame to equip, unisex.

Images rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-223.html

Note: This might be a World Clock era-specific recipe. Haven't confirmed that as of yet.
